email.subject: Quick fix for Gearhead Group's site
email.body:
Hi Kofi,

Looked at Gearhead Group Auto Care's site. Two things are likely costing you booked jobs: there's no click-to-call button, so mobile visitors searching "auto repair Harbor Falls" have to copy your number instead of tapping to dial. And your hours aren't listed anywhere, so people unsure if you're open just call the next shop.

Both are quick fixes. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough and show you exactly what I'd change, no obligation.

Worth a quick call this week?

Alex
Northlight Web
